advices.diagnosis: The class has low cohesion (LCOM4=2) because its methods operate on unrelated data: title uses only a formatting width, describe_customer works solely with a Customer argument, order_count accesses the repository, and mail_summary touches both the repository and the mailer. It also couples to two internal classes (DCC=2). The small method count (NOM=4) and modest complexity (WMC=4) suggest the class could be split without inflating its size.

suggestions.title: Extract mail_summary to a dedicated EmailReport helper

advices.risk_notes: Introducing EmailReport adds a new public class; callers must be updated to provide it, which may require changes in dependency injection wiring. If EmailReport is used elsewhere, its interface must remain stable. The refactor does not affect business logic, but test suites need to be adjusted to mock the new helper.
